components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one committed action per surface. Banker's Blue, white text, hover lightens.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #3b82f6); color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 14px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #60a5fa; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #2563eb; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3b82f6); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Form control: hairline slate border, dark fill, accent focus ring, rose error state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--fg-2, #b4bfcc); } .ds-input { width: 100%; border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.35); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(30,41,59,0.8); color: var(--fg-1, #f0f1f5); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--fg-3, #8896a8); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #3b82f6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent, #3b82f6); } .ds-field-hint { font-size: 11px; color: var(--fg-3, #8896a8); }

components.name: Rail Navigation
components.description: The left rail: brand, wayfinding, footer controls. Active item carries the accent and a 3px wayfinding bar.
components.html: PPension-Pal
components.css: .ds-rail { width: 220px; background: var(--surface, #13141a); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); padding: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-rail-mark { width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 5px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent, #3b82f6), #1e40af); color: #fff; font-weight: 800; font-size: 13px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-rail-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--fg-1, #f0f1f5); letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-rail-btn { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; padding: 5px 10px; border: none; border-left: 3px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg-2, #b4bfcc); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-rail-btn:hover { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.08); color: var(--accent, #3b82f6); } .ds-rail-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3b82f6); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-rail-btn.ds-active { background: rgba(59,130,246,0.15); color: var(--accent, #3b82f6); border-left-color: var(--accent, #3b82f6); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Felt-pad track with a raised active pill: the one control allowed an offset shadow.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; gap: 3px; padding: 2px; background: var(--surface-2, #1a1b23); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-seg-btn { flex: 1; padding: 6px 10px; border: none; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--fg-3, #8896a8); font: 600 11px/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms, color 120ms, box-shadow 120ms; } .ds-seg-btn:hover { color: var(--fg-1, #f0f1f5); } .ds-seg-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3b82f6); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-seg-btn.ds-active { background: var(--surface, #13141a); color: var(--fg-1, #f0f1f5); box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.45), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Low-emphasis toggle for filters and variants; the active state commits the accent at low saturation.
components.css: .ds-chip { border: 1px solid rgba(51,65,85,0.9); background: rgba(15,23,42,0.4); color: var(--fg-2, #b4bfcc); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 11px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms, background 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: rgba(71,85,105,0.9); background: rgba(30,41,59,0.7); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #3b82f6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip.ds-active { border-color: rgba(59,130,246,0.5); background: rgba(59,130,246,0.2); color: #dbeafe; }

narrative.overview: A banker's desk after hours: a dark room, documents laid out side by side for one decision, and a single pool of light that falls exactly where attention is needed. Pension-Pal is that desk. The interface stays quiet and dark so the numbers carry the light; everything on screen earns its place. Precise, premium, calm, and human: aligned Swiss-formatted figures, one confident accent, plain-spoken copy for 55+ readers. Sister of Budget-Pal, Fintools, and Application-Pal.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first; light mode is a fully equal citizen
Data-dense and compact; whitespace is spent on grouping, never on padding
One accent hue; semantic colors appear only as meaning
Depth through tonal layering; shadows are dark, offset, and rare
Motion is short, purposeful, and honors prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Banker's Blue appears on <=10% of any screen. It marks the current decision; its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green, red, and yellow encode financial meaning only — never decoration, branding, or chart variety beyond the categorical set.

rules.name: The Two-Theme Rule
rules.body: Every surface, text, and accent color must resolve to an AA-compliant value in both dark and light via styles.css token pairs.

rules.name: The Instrument Rule
rules.body: Numbers use tabular figures and right alignment; money follows Swiss formatting (1'234.50). Never center a column of numbers.

rules.name: The Floor Rule
rules.body: 14px body floor, 11px labels, 9px only for rail micro-labels. Nothing readable goes smaller.

rules.name: The Grouping Rule
rules.body: Tight internals, clear separation: 4-8px inside a control, 12-16px between fields, 24-28px between sections.

rules.name: The Lamplight Rule
rules.body: In dark mode depth is a shadow, not a halo: dark, offset, blurred. Zero-offset colored glows are forbidden as elevation.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces are flat: tonal step + hairline border. Shadows announce floating layers only.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: One-pixel token borders separate every surface; if a separation needs more, use a tonal step, not a heavier line.

dos: Route every color through styles.css tokens and every chart color through chartColors.ts
Keep dark and light token values paired when adding a token
Use data-theme theming (the dark: Tailwind variant is not used)
Reuse rail, segmented-control, and popover-smooth patterns with their documented motion contract
Write numbers in Swiss format, right-aligned in tables
donts: Introduce hues beyond Banker's Blue + the three semantic colors
Hard-code hex values in components, including chart strokes
Use zero-offset glow shadows for elevation in dark mode
Animate layout properties except the rail width transition
Use the dark: class variant; theming is exclusively [data-theme=light] token overrides
Fill missing values with example data — missing stays empty
